traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Laurales page (read 2026-10-16): order characterisation gives opposite leaves, but Lauraceae plus Hernandiaceae have spiral leaves; Lauraceae (about 2,850 spp.) is most of the order's species, so 'alternate usually' is weighed by species. All other families opposite.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Laurales page (read 2026-10-16): Lauraceae leaves mostly spiral, rarely two-ranked; Hernandiaceae spiral; the opposite-leaved families have crossing pairs.

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Laurales page (read 2026-10-16): leaves simple in all families; only Hernandiaceae (Illigera) has some palmately compound leaves (DELTA Hernandiaceae).

traits.leaf_habit.note: APweb, Laurales page (read 2026-10-16): Lauraceae mostly evergreen with some deciduous members (e.g. Lindera, Sassafras); Calycanthaceae both habits; tropical Monimiaceae, Siparunaceae, Atherospermataceae evergreen (inferred from distribution).

traits.life_span.note: APweb, Laurales page (read 2026-10-16): trees, shrubs and lianas; even the parasitic Cassytha is a perennial vine.

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Laurales page (read 2026-10-16): woody plants with leaves along the stems; no rosettes.

traits.flowering_position.note: DELTA Monimiaceae page (read 2026-10-16): inflorescences mostly axillary; APweb Laurales page: Lauraceae inflorescences on the new flush, typically in leaf axils (our reading); Calycanthaceae flowers terminal on short shoots.

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb, Laurales page (read 2026-10-16): order characterisation: hypanthium usually present; absent in Gomortegaceae.

traits.fruit_type.note: APweb, Laurales page (read 2026-10-16): fruits indehiscent; Lauraceae a fleshy one-seeded fruit; Monimiaceae, Calycanthaceae, Atherospermataceae achenes or drupelets. Weighted by Lauraceae.

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb, Laurales page (read 2026-10-16): Lauraceae flowers mostly perfect, some tribes dioecious; Monimiaceae and Siparunaceae often unisexual. Weighted by Lauraceae.
